# Document editor

One editor for everything people write in Whity: templates Whity Render prints, letters, reports, notes and wiki pages. It takes blocks and speed from Notion and Gutenberg, and pages, comments and suggestions from Google Docs. Agents write in it as suggestions only. The design system defines it (decisions E.1–E.39, the Document editor cards, `handoff/editor/`); the Whity team builds it (E.1).

## The shell

| Part | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| Header (56px) | Back, the document's icon, title, path and save state; the mode (Editing, Suggesting, Viewing); comments; PDF; **Publish** for templates, the one action on the plane (E.9) |
| Toolbar (44px) | Google Docs order: undo, redo · style · bold, italic, underline, strikethrough · link, highlight · lists · Insert · Field · comment · Ask an agent · view, zoom, outline (E.5) |
| Body | The outline (220px), the canvas on the grey ground, the margin rail (300px) with comment and suggestion cards beside their text (E.6) |
| Status bar (28px) | Words, language, type, pages, who edited last |

Under 1280px the outline closes; under 1024px the rail becomes a drawer; under 768px the toolbar scrolls and the bubble and / menu carry the rest.

## Two views

- **Continuous** (notes, wiki): one sheet on the grey ground, 760px with 616px of text, following the theme; a per-document Full width switch for wide tables (E.34).
- **Page view** (templates, anything that prints): A4 pages at 16mm margins with the letterhead, running header and "Page x of y", white in both themes like paper (E.7, E.11). **Preview with a record** fills the fields with a record's values and hides comments and suggestions (the rail says so); it's read-only until Show fields (E.12).

![The editor shell: header, toolbar, outline, continuous sheet, margin rail](data:image/png;base64,)

## Blocks

Text, Heading 1–3, Quote, Code · Bulleted, Numbered, Checklist · Callout (Note, Important) · Toggle, Columns, Divider, Page break · Table, Image, File · Record and Chart (live), Signature and stamp (E.13–E.16). Tables are document tables; data comes in as live Record and Chart blocks, frozen in each PDF at render time.

**Block chrome:** hovering a block shows + and a drag handle in the margin; the handle drags or opens the block menu (Turn into, Comment, Duplicate, Move, Delete). Selecting a table, image, callout or embed shows its own toolbar above it (E.8).

**Plugin blocks:** plugins add blocks through the block registry. Verified and first-party plugins render natively with the Whity SDK; others in a sandboxed frame. A block needs a print view to be used in templates. A disabled plugin leaves a placeholder that keeps the data and blocks publishing. Each plugin gets its own group in the / menu (E.17–E.20).

**Saved blocks:** select several blocks and Save as block, Synced (edit once, every document updates) or Copy, for Only me or the workspace; synced blocks can leave parts to fill per document (E.21–E.24). A published template picks up a synced block's change at its next publish (E.38).

## Writing

- **The / menu and +:** every block, grouped (Whity's, Saved blocks, one group per plugin, Ask an agent last), filtered as you type. Markdown shortcuts are on; ⌘Z right after reverts one (E.28).
- **Links:** ⌘K with text selected adds a link; with nothing selected it opens the command palette (E.36).
- **The bubble:** bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, link, highlight (one colour, E.25), comment, Rewrite.
- **Merge fields:** `{{` or Field ▾; a chip with the field's plain name on the tint (E.26). Preview shows values; a missing value is flagged, and Whity Render won't issue a document with a required field missing (E.27).

## Comments, suggestions and agents

- **Modes:** Editing, Suggesting (every edit is a suggestion), Viewing. People who can't edit are in Suggesting (E.10). Suggested text is dashed: insertions in the main colour, deletions struck through. Comments mark their text with the warning tint, on screen only (E.39).
- **Deciding:** anyone who can edit accepts or rejects any suggestion, an agent's included, and the decision is logged (E.29). Publishing a template is checked first: open suggestions, a block whose plugin is off, a block without a print view or an unknown field each block it (E.37).
- **Agents:** asked from the / menu, the toolbar, Rewrite, or an @mention in a comment, where they reply in the thread (E.30). They read the document and the records it references, within their and the person's permissions (E.31). Everything they write arrives as a dashed, attributed suggestion (E.4). They act unprompted only on a routine an owner sets up (E.32).

## Type

| | On screen | On paper |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Title | Readex Pro 600, 31px | Readex Pro 600, 22pt, the tenant's colour |
| Headings | Noto Sans 600, 24 · 20 · 18px | Noto Sans 600, 14 · 12 · 10.5pt |
| Body | Noto Sans 16px, line height 1.5 (Arabic 1.7) | 9.5pt (stage 6) |

Arabic titles use Readex Pro's Arabic design (E.35). In Arabic the shell mirrors, each block follows its own text direction, and numbers, codes and amounts stay Western and left to right (section 8).

## For engineering

`handoff/editor/whity-document.ts` is the contract: the document model, marks, blocks, comments and suggestions, the block registry and plugin manifest, saved blocks, the editor's props and the publish checks. `handoff/editor/README.md` maps each part onto TipTap and ProseMirror. Live collaboration (cursors, presence, version history) comes after the first version (E.3).
